verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documented export capability for Google Drive: no Takeout, no bulk export, and no open-format conversion. The files.list API (docs-10) is only a developer building block that could be used to construct an export. The community's rclone-to-ODF route (comm-5, comm-13) is a third-party, user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.
